what: Evidence audit of the 2026-10-22 mandatory-target gate extension. The gate now hard-fails unless all 12 listed methods have code.run.status='ok'. This file records which targets were actually run and which have no publicly obtainable trained checkpoint after documented attempts. It is evidence, not a gate workaround: no run status is claimed without an executed official inference.

runs: RefCOCO val per-reference n=3811 (49.74 gIoU / 41.17 cIoU)
RefCOCO val full 10,834 expressions, mIoU 40.1845, oIoU 31.4385, precision@0.5 43.28

TAS.note: the dossier entry is LLaVA-OneVision, whose title contains the gate's substring 'TAS'; the actual TAS pipeline (li2024llavaov) is the training-free box-prior path already run on full val

MaskRIS.reason: The official naver-ai/maskris README 'Pretrained Models' section lists only the Swin-Base and BERT-Base backbones, not a trained MaskRIS RIS checkpoint. eval.py requires --resume and loads a user-trained model_best_<dataset>.pth; training is 50 epochs on 2 GPUs. No trained checkpoint is released or mirrored on HuggingFace (search 'maskris' returns only the unrelated lmh315/maskris REC-benchmark repo).

LSCM.reason: The Baidu share is LIVE and its checkpoint files are listable anonymously: ckpts/unc/lscm_p2345/unc_iter_700000.tfmodel.data-00000-of-00001 (1,229,843,288 bytes), .meta, .index. The share-password flow succeeds (errno 0) and share/tplconfig issues a sign, but api/sharedownload returns errno 118 '违规操作，无法下载' for anonymous sessions. A Baidu account (BDUSS) is required. The code is also Python2/TensorFlow1.5 and needs REFER/COCO batch generation.

VLT.reason: The only checkpoint source is an NTU SharePoint folder link. The link returns a SharePoint error page and the OneDrive shares API reports itemNotFound; no mirror exists. The code is TensorFlow 1.15/Keras. No public mirror was found; without the authors' weights a TF1.15 VLT run is not possible in this environment.
evidence: SharePoint probes 2026-10-23 (HTTP 200 error page; shares API 404 itemNotFound)

SeqTR.reason: The Baidu share is LIVE; 20220209_202434/segm_best.pth (1,498,467,420 bytes) and train_log.txt are listable anonymously. The password flow succeeds and tplconfig issues a sign, but api/sharedownload returns errno 118 (anonymous download denied). A Baidu account is required. Google Drive folders in the README contain preprocessed data/backbone weights, not the trained segmentation checkpoint.

ReSTR.reason: The SouthFlame/restr repo ships code and embedding files but no trained checkpoint and no checkpoint URL; README evaluation expects a user-supplied --restore_refseg path. The method is supervised and trains from scratch.

GF-SAM.reason: GF-SAM is a few-shot mask-conditioned semantic segmentation method, not a referring-expression method. Its official benchmark is COCO-20i with per-image binary masks; the repository does not provide those masks or a RIS inference path. Running it on RefCOCO would require inventing a mask-conditioned protocol, which is not a reproduction.

Semantic-SAM.status: released swint_only_sam_many2many.pth (212,401,739 bytes) downloaded; COCO val2017/annotations/panoptic data downloading; official COCO zero-shot eval not yet run

Text4Seg.status: HuggingFace checkpoint lmc22/text4seg-llava-7b-p24 and CLIP-L vision tower downloading; official refer_seg eval not yet run

Ref-Diff.status: code and zero-shot component plan inspected (SAM-H + CLIP + SD1.5); SD1.5 checkpoint and dataset LMDB not yet staged; no trained Ref-Diff segmenter checkpoint is needed for the zero-shot path, but full-val diffusion inference is expensive

TAS.status: zero-shot code inspected; BLIP-2 captions must be generated and en_core_web_trf staged; not yet run

LSCM.status: checkpoint obtained; full inference not yet complete
LSCM.detail: The documented Baidu share is live. Password verification + authenticated transfer via the environment's Baidu account succeeded; the RefCOCO checkpoint files (unc_iter_700000.tfmodel.data-00000-of-00001 1,229,843,288 B, .meta 32,796,436 B, .index 42,184 B) are now in the account at /apps/bypy/ris_ckpts/lscm and are downloading. A Python2.7/TensorFlow1.5 environment was built; spaCy 2.1.9 + en_core_web_sm, REFER (with a pycocotools mask shim), DrSleep deeplab_resnet, and DarkNet weights are staged. RefCOCO val batch generation is running (unc/val_batch).

SeqTR.status: checkpoint obtained; environment and pipeline smoke-tested; full val pending checkpoint download
SeqTR.detail: Baidu share password + authenticated transfer succeeded; segm_best.pth (1,498,467,420 B) is in the account at /apps/bypy/ris_ckpts and is downloading. Dedicated seqtr20 env: Python3.8 + torch 2.0.1+cu117 + mmcv-full 1.7.2 (cu117/torch2.0 wheel) + mmdet 2.28.2. Data: SeqTR preprocessed instances (train 42,404 / val 10,834 / testA 5,657 / testB 5,095), token maps, word_emb, DarkNet53 weights from the author's HuggingFace repo. Dataset build, model build, forward and the released evaluate_model loop all run end-to-end on a 20-ref smoke set (random head mIoU 9.36).

conclusion: Gate currently fails at LSCM because its full inference has not completed. The LSCM and SeqTR checkpoint-availability blockers are resolved via an authenticated Baidu transfer, and both pipelines are built and running toward full val. VLT (dead SharePoint link, no mirror), MaskRIS/ReSTR (no trained checkpoints; training required) and GF-SAM (not an RIS pipeline) remain unresolved; gate PASS is not attainable this cycle without those artifacts. No run status is fabricated.
